subject.title: [Bug] v2026.5.22: System envelope footer ("Sender label echoed for confirmation only…") echoed verbatim into Telegram outbound on group+topic sessions with audio inbound

question: Should OpenClaw require current-main Telegram/Bedrock reproduction before adding an outbound footer scrubber, or accept a narrowly scoped defense-in-depth guard now while investigating the provider/prompt-cache path separately?
rationale: The evidence separates an intentional Telegram General-topic transport behavior from a historically observed internal-text leak, but it does not establish whether a current prompt-construction defect remains or what text-removal boundary is acceptable.

options.title: Reproduce before changing sanitization
options.body: Run a redacted current-main General-topic Telegram/Bedrock scenario and use the observed prompt and completion boundary to choose the smallest safe repair.

options.title: Add a narrow output guard now
options.body: Suppress only the complete known internal footer shape in final outbound assistant text, with false-positive coverage and a separate investigation of prompt construction.

options.title: Treat current prompt changes as sufficient
options.body: Close only if maintainers can provide current-main production evidence that the exact envelope is no longer reachable and no equivalent leak remains.

recommendation.title: Reproduce before changing sanitization
recommendation.body: Run a redacted current-main General-topic Telegram/Bedrock scenario and use the observed prompt and completion boundary to choose the smallest safe repair.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the assigned owner and the open question is an explicit security-boundary choice.
